//: Thumbnail capture config for scripts/thumbs.mjs. One entry per demo; 'name' is both demos/<name>/web/ and the output media/<name>.png. Optional per demo: 'settleMs' (wait after the .wasm loads before capturing; default below), 'rast' (?rast= mode, default gles2), 'arg' (&arg=...), and 'steps' — a list run after the settle wait to get the demo into a photogenic state: {"key":"g"} presses a key (Playwright key name, optional "repeat"), {"wait":ms} pauses, {"rightClick":[x,y]} opens a pup menu at x,y, {"pick":[mx,my,k]} clicks item k of the pup menu whose top-left is at mx,my, {"drag":[x1,y1,x2,y2]} left-drags. The capture is the whole 1024x768 viewport, box-filtered down 2x to 512x384.
